integrity: Proof derives set-theoretic equality from explicit matrix equations, includes boundary and characteristic-two cases, and uses rank-one cone dimensions. Finite-field checker is corroborative and not an infinite-field proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced geometric variety is classified. Finite-field aggregate count was implied by an earlier prescribed-product enumeration. No claims concerning nonreduced structure, scheme multiplicity, higher matrix sizes or certified historical priority.
title: Three determinantal components of commuting square-zero pairs in the four-by-four nilradical
